header.h1: I design clear, modern and effective interfaces.
header.p: I help startups, agencies and entrepreneurs turn their ideas into functional, consistent and intuitive interfaces.
approach.p1: I start each project with an in-depth understanding of needs, users and strategic goals. This phase helps identify key challenges and define a clear direction for the rest of the project.
approach.p2: Once the objectives are clarified, I structure the information and design the first user flows. This step lays the functional foundations and ensures a smooth and coherent experience.
approach.p3: I design modern and efficient interfaces aligned with the brand identity and user expectations. The design system ensures visual consistency, while prototypes facilitate testing and validation.
approach.p4: I prepare complete deliverables for development, carry out the necessary tests and optimize interactions when needed. The goal is to ensure a reliable launch and continuous product improvement.

project.horecaseek.title: HorecaSeek
project.horecaseek.subtitle: Desktop-first web app to discover restaurants by region in Belgium.
project.horecaseek.context.title: Context & problem
project.horecaseek.context.text: Finding a good restaurant online is often time-consuming. Existing platforms are overloaded, hard to read and make comparison difficult.
project.horecaseek.objectives.title: Objectives
project.horecaseek.objective1: Find a restaurant in under 2 minutes
project.horecaseek.role.title: My role
project.horecaseek.role.text: UX/UI Designer — research, wireframes, UI design and design system.
project.horecaseek.process.title: UX process
project.horecaseek.process.text: The work started with defining the main user flow and prioritizing the listing screen, which is the core of the experience.
project.horecaseek.wireframes.title: Wireframes
project.horecaseek.wireframes.text: Low-fidelity desktop wireframes focused on information hierarchy and filter clarity.
project.horecaseek.ui.title: UI & design system
project.horecaseek.ui.text: A minimalist and structured interface based on reusable components and a strong typographic hierarchy.
project.horecaseek.result.title: Result
project.horecaseek.result.text: A clear and efficient experience that allows users to quickly discover restaurants suited to their context.
project.horecaseek.learnings.title: Learnings
project.horecaseek.learnings.text: This project taught me how to prioritize features and simplify a product that was initially too ambitious.
project.rhumer.title: Rhumer
project.rhumer.subtitle: Mobile app to discover, scan and explore rum bottles.
project.rhumer.context.title: Context & problem
project.rhumer.context.text: Discovering rums in store or at home is often limited to labels and price, with little contextual information or guidance.
project.rhumer.objectives.title: Objectives
project.rhumer.objective2: Provide clear and structured product information
project.rhumer.objective3: Create a smooth and immersive mobile experience
project.rhumer.role.title: My role
project.rhumer.role.text: UX/UI Designer — mobile UX, wireframes, UI design and visual exploration.
project.rhumer.process.title: UX process
project.rhumer.process.text: The project focused on mobile-first exploration, from onboarding to bottle discovery and scanning.
project.rhumer.wireframes.title: Wireframes
project.rhumer.wireframes.text: Low-fidelity mobile wireframes exploring navigation, scanning flow and product pages.
project.rhumer.ui.title: UI & visual direction
project.rhumer.ui.text: A dark and warm interface inspired by the rum universe, mixing typography, textures and illustrations.
project.rhumer.result.title: Result
project.rhumer.result.text: An immersive mobile experience focused on discovery, learning and exploration.
project.rhumer.learnings.title: Learnings
project.rhumer.learnings.text: This project allowed me to explore mobile UX patterns and experiment with a strong visual identity.
